Acquire the open-branch discriminating probe rather than adding generic trajectories or claiming the process is unknown.

Deferred: the current failure is not simply too few rows or short horizon—the eight-row ODE fit already misses both training and confirmation by a wide margin.
Rejected: it is explicitly nuisance/high-variance and does not target the observed mechanism ambiguity.
